scanWindow: Since the 2026-09-08 completed scan, plus material missed developments from the previous 48 hours
notes: Completed the 2026-09-09 editorial scan and published one Daily Brief. Meta's September 8 Muse launch cleared the Must know threshold because it moves a mainstream consumer assistant into real cross-app action, with an official English primary source describing the Muse Secure VM and permission model and Reuters providing useful independent security context. The brief avoids Meta's unsupported 'world's first' framing and focuses on the durable shift toward assistants operating privileged user accounts. Reuters reporting on U.S. accusations that several Chinese AI firms copied U.S. model technology was logged Worth knowing but not published because the claims are contested government allegations rather than a new technical release or standard. Reuters reporting on OpenAI using its models in chip design and expanding industry-specific enterprise offerings was also held because the strongest new claims were conference remarks rather than a dedicated primary technical release. Qualcomm-Amazon AI infrastructure reporting scored Worth knowing but did not displace the stronger agent launch and currently lacks enough primary technical detail for a concise AI Compass brief. Cognition's funding round was logged Watch as financing news with limited durable reader action. No rumours, filler, unsupported rankings, unverified pricing or unsourced claims were published.
